senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. פוח)to evaporate, become faint; to escape.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:5">Tosef. Sabb. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:5">IV</cite>), 5 <he>שתָּפוּג צינתן</he> sufficient time for the cold in them to escape; <cite ref="Shabbat 40b">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>שתפוג</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שתָּפִיג</he>); Y. ib. III, 6ᵇ top <he>שתפיג</he>.
<cite ref="Keritot 6b:9">Ker. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שלא תפוג ריחה</he> that its fragrance may not escape.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:9:2">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵈ</cite> top <he>שטעמן פָּג</he> their flavor would escape; a. fr.
<cite ref="Eruvin 64b:9">Erub. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיָפִיג יינינו</he> until the wine we drank has escaped (the effect of the wine is overcome).

senses.gloss: to lose taste, intensity; to cause to escape; to cool off; to mitigate.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 41a:7">Pes. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מים שאין מְפִיגִין טעמן</he> water, which does not give up its taste (to the substance boiled in it) <he>שאר משקין שמפיגין וכ׳</he> other liquids, which do communicate their taste.
<cite ref="Beitzah 14a:5">Bets. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>כל התבלין מפיגין טעמן … מְפִיגָה וכ׳</he> all spices lose their taste (when pounded a day before), but salt does not &c.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 79:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIX</cite> <he>ה׳ את חמתו וכ׳</he> let out his anger on wood and stone.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 22b:13">Snh. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דרך … מפיגין את היין</he> a walk of a mile, or a little sleep cause the wine to escape (counteract the effect of the wine); Erub. l. c. Ib. <he>שדרך מפיגה וכ׳</he> that walking counteracts &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:12">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>יין מְפִיגוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00446"><he>פַּחַד</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:7">Yoma I, 7</cite> <he>והָפֵג אחת וכ׳</he> and drive out (thy drowsiness, cool thy feet) &c., v. <cite ref="A00994"><he>אֶחָד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 75b:11-13">Ib. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>דברים … מן מְפִיגָן</he> the manna counteracted the effect of such food as traders sold them; a. e.
